description: This file contains repository classes for managing database entities related to roles, skills, recommendations, and progress tracking in a career pathway navigator application, using SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository for Role entities and related structures.

classes.name: RecommendationRepository
classes.description: Repository for recommendations related to role-skill mappings.

classes.name: ProgressRepository
classes.description: Repository for progress tracking of roles and skills.

methods.name: list_roles
methods.description: Return all roles sorted by name.

methods.name: get_role_by_name
methods.description: Fetch a role by its unique name.

methods.name: get_role_by_id
methods.description: Fetch a role by its numeric ID.

methods.name: create_role
methods.description: Create a new role with the given name.

methods.name: attach_skill
methods.description: Attach a skill to a role with a required level.

methods.name: list_skills
methods.description: Return all skills sorted by name.

methods.name: get_skill_by_name
methods.description: Fetch a skill by its unique name.

methods.name: get_skill_by_id
methods.description: Fetch a skill by its numeric ID.

methods.name: create_skill
methods.description: Create a new skill with optional category and description.

methods.name: add_recommendation
methods.description: Create a recommendation for a role-skill mapping.

methods.name: set_progress
methods.description: Create or update progress for role/skill.

methods.name: get_progress
methods.description: Get progress for a specific role/skill.

methods.name: list_role_progress
methods.description: List all progress entries for a role.
